people.name: František
people.notes:
Research subject of this file. MyHeritage gave birth '1926-01-01' in Kyjov; '1 Jan' is a placeholder and the family lived in Moravský Písek, so the birthplace was changed to Moravský Písek (probable; his own 1926 birth record is not online yet). Birth year 1926 and death 2009 confirmed by the family grave 'Rodina Lovecká' in Moravský Písek (S0113).

Parents identified 2026-11-14: František Lovecký (1900–1984) and Františka Tihlaříková (1904–1996), married 8 Nov 1925 (S0101); confirmed by the grave. Sister Anička (1932–1935).

Childhood homes: Moravský Písek no. 57 (1925) and no. 405 (1935).

people.name: Martin
people.notes:
Smallholder (Viertler / čtvrtník) in Moravský Písek, house no. 41 in 1805. Father of Jan (1805) (S0122). The 1784–1809 births index lists other Lovecký children who may be his (e.g. Thomas 1804, Marianna 1805/1806).

Unresolved (2026-11-14): the 1784–1851 marriages book has only two Martin Lovecký weddings, and neither bride is Mechtildis: 20 Jan 1790, Martin, smallholder at no. 76, aged 26, to Katharina, daughter of Matthias Kobližek?, cottager (S0123); and 1 May 1810, Martin, WIDOWER, smallholder at no. 76, aged 46, to Josepha, daughter of the late Martin Andrlík, cottager, aged 23 (S0124). Both are probably the same man (born c. 1764). If he is Jan's father, he married Mechtildis between 1790 and 1805 somewhere else (probably her home parish), and she died before 1810. Not proven: Jan's father lived at no. 41 in 1805, not no. 76. The 1784–1820 deaths index (image 67) has no Mechtildis Lovecká; it lists Katharina Lovecká twice (fol. 35 and 45), but fol. 35 (image 36, Aug 1804–Jan 1805) did not show her, so the folio number was probably misread.

people.name: Josef
people.notes:
Father of Alena Sládková (P0092). On the family grave 'Rodina Sládkova' in Moravský Písek (S0125): born 25 Nov 1928, died 3 Aug 1968, 'trag. smrtí' (tragic death).

PROBABLE parents (2026-11-15): Jiří Sládek (b. 1905, Dolní Bojanovice) and Františka Janečková (b. 1908, Prušánky), married 11 May 1928 in Dolní Bojanovice (S0141) — Josef was born 6½ months later (25 Nov 1928); the bride was a minor and married with her guardian's consent. Other candidates: Jiří's brothers František (m. 1923, S0140) and Petr (m. 1925, S0142), and Rudolf Sládek (m. 1921, not checked). In every case except Rudolf, the paternal grandparents are František Sládek (podsedník) and Kateřina Šupová. Proof needs Josef's birth record (registry office).

sources.title: Stupava births 1864–1900 and marriages 1864–1904: indexes F (negative search for Formánek)
sources.notes: Births 1864–1900 (MZA book 12020, index image 234; mza_12020_234_stupava_births_index_F1/F2.png): no Formánek at all. Marriages 1864–1904 (MZA book 12026 = detail 9730, index image 121): one Formánek only — fol. 52 (image 52, mza_12026_052_jakub_formanek1897.png), 10 Aug 1897: Jakub Formánek, bricklayer of Jestřabí? ('v Jastřížli'), minor, son of Jakub Formánek, cottager there, and Anna née Jan Čech, cottager in Kunovice; bride Františka, daughter of Felix Ištvan?, cottager in Stupava. NOT our line (parents Jakub × Čechová, not Jan × Kalábová) — possibly a distant relative. So Jan Formánek (podsedník from Stupava) married Františka Kalábová and had son František BEFORE 1864, when Stupava belonged to Osvětimany parish.
